name: Hakko FA-400 Benchtop Solder Smoke Absorber
description: Protect your lungs and keep your workshop air clear with this premium benchtop solder smoke absorber! The Hakko FA-400 is the industry standard for removing toxic fumes, flux smoke, and unpleasant odors from your soldering workspace. Designed with a highly efficient activated carbon filter sheet, it quickly draws in and captures airborne contaminants. It features an ESD-safe rugged housing, a high-performance low-noise internal exhaust fan, and an ingenious dual-angle stand design—lay it flat for maximum high-velocity suction or stand it vertically for standard benchtop filtering. Fully functional, exceptionally clean, and an absolute health necessity for any serious hardware hacker or electronics repair tech!
contact_note: Includes the FA-400 smoke absorber unit and a clean activated carbon filter sheet already installed. Thoroughly wiped down and functions perfectly. Ready for pickup!
meta_description: Pre-owned Hakko FA-400 benchtop solder smoke absorber in good condition. Features ESD-safe body, activated carbon filtration, dual-angle operation, low noise exhaust fan.
name_zh: 白光 Hakko FA-400 台式防静电焊锡抽烟机/吸烟仪
description_zh: 电子硬件工程师和DIY焊接玩家守护肺部健康的终极利器！这款工业级白光 Hakko FA-400 台式吸烟仪，能高效吸除和过滤焊接时产生的松香有害烟雾、松香气味和松香残渣。采用高品质活性炭滤网，配合内部大吸力、低噪音的排风扇。具有卓越的 ESD-Safe 防静电设计，完全不会损伤脆弱的电路板芯片。机身支持独特的双角度放置：平放时可实现近距离高速强力吸除，立放时适合标准台面排烟。整体成色非常干净，运转平稳正常。
